# Instrument reference

## Settings

Link a page or a row as `[Label](instrument://settings/<name>)`, with the name in backticks below. Settings opens at it, and a row is scrolled to and lit. Settings opens with ⌘, on a Mac (Ctrl+, elsewhere).

### General (`general`)

Your account, how Instrument looks, notifications, updates, and the diagnostic log.

- **Account** (`account`): Your Instrument account and plan. On it: Log out (`log-out`).
- **Theme** (`theme`): Choose your preferred color scheme.
- **Zoom** (`zoom`): Make everything in the app larger or smaller.
- **Notify when tasks finish** (`notifications`): Show a desktop notification when a task finishes. On it: Send a test notification (`test-notification`).
- **Version and updates** (`version`): Which version of Instrument you have, and updates. On it: Release notes (`release-notes`), Check for updates (`check-for-updates`).
- **Open source** (`open-source`): View the source, or tell us about something that isn't working. On it: View source on GitHub (`view-source`), Report a bug (`report-bug`).
- **Diagnostic log** (`diagnostic-log`): A local record to send with a problem report. On it: View log (`view-log`).

### Memory (`memory`)

What Instrument remembers about you, which you can search, forget, or add to from another AI.

- **Import from another AI** (`memory-import`): Bring in what another AI knows about you.

### Providers (`providers`)

The AI models Instrument can use: your ChatGPT or Claude plan, or a provider you add with your own key.

- **Add provider** (`add-provider`): Use a model with your own key.
- **ChatGPT account** (`chatgpt-account`): Use your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan.
- **Claude account** (`claude-account`): Use your Claude plan.

### Skills (`skills`)

The skills Instrument's tasks can use, and making a new one.

- **New skill** (`new-skill`): Ask for a skill that teaches a new way of working.

### Storage (`storage`)

Where your chats and tasks live, and fixing ones whose folders have problems.

The sidebar lists this page only when some chats or tasks have problems in their folders, though a link opens it either way.

- **Workspace location** (`workspace-location`): Where your chats and tasks live on this computer.
- **Broken chats and tasks** (`broken-folders`): Chats and tasks with problems in their folders.

## Screens

Link one as `[Label](instrument://screen/<name>)`.

- **Apps** (`apps`): The services Instrument can work in for you, and connecting one.
- **Browser** (`browser`): A browser of your own, which tasks can work in beside you.
- **Release notes** (`release-notes`): What changed in each version.
- **Keyboard shortcuts** (`shortcuts`): Every keyboard shortcut, by section.

## Keyboard shortcuts

Each is written as on a Mac, then as on Windows and Linux.

### General

- Close Window: ⇧⌘W / Ctrl+Shift+W
- Command Menu: ⌘K / Ctrl+K
- Go to Apps: ⌃⌘4 / Alt+4
- Go to Browser: ⌃⌘3 / Alt+3
- Go to Chat: ⌃⌘1 / Alt+1
- Go to Files: ⌃⌘2 / Alt+2
- Keyboard Shortcuts: ? / ?
- New Chat: ⌘N / Ctrl+N
- Search or Ask: ⌘L / Ctrl+L
- Settings...: ⌘, / Ctrl+,

### Chats

- Next Chat: ⌥⌘↓ / Ctrl+Alt+↓
- Paste as Text: ⇧⌘V / Ctrl+Shift+V
- Previous Chat: ⌥⌘↑ / Ctrl+Alt+↑
- Toggle Inbox: ⌘B / Ctrl+B

### Tabs

- Close Tab: ⌘W / Ctrl+W
- Last Tab: ⌘9 / Ctrl+9
- New Tab: ⌘T / Ctrl+T
- Reopen Closed Tab: ⇧⌘T / Ctrl+Shift+T
- Show Next Tab: ⌃Tab / Ctrl+Tab
- Show Previous Tab: ⌃⇧Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab
- Tab 1 to 8: ⌘1…8 / Ctrl+1…8

### Pages

- Back: ⌘[ / Ctrl+[
- Edit Page: ⌘E / Ctrl+E
- Find in Page: ⌘F / Ctrl+F
- Forward: ⌘] / Ctrl+]
- Reload Page: ⌘R / Ctrl+R

### View

- Actual Size: ⌘0 / Ctrl+0
- Toggle Full Screen: ⌃⌘F / F11
- Zoom In: ⌘+ / Ctrl++
- Zoom Out: ⌘- / Ctrl+-
